lines.text: Paul's crew sailed to Cos, Rhodes and Patara, then boarded a ship crossing to Phoenicia and landed at Tyre.
At Tyre they stayed seven days, and through the Spirit the disciples kept telling Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
They landed at Ptolemais, then went on to Caesarea and stayed at the home of Philip the evangelist.
A prophet named Agabus came down from Samaria and bound his own hands and feet with Paul's belt.
They went on to Jerusalem, and some disciples from Caesarea took them to stay at the home of Mnason the Egyptian.
